en: Sauttaraduka (The Dyad on Having a Superior)
Dependent on a non-supramundane state, a non-supramundane state arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a non-superlative state, a non-superlative state arises by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on both a non-supramundane and a non-superlative state, a non-superlative state arises by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two …pe… in the non-disappearance condition, five.
